umiPos.stateManagement: ChangeNotifier with one explicit composition root

umiPos.cashPayment: exact cash, cash received, server-confirmed change, and denomination shortcuts
umiPos.manualTerminal: operator-confirmed external result; no provider proof; unknown outcomes are query-only
umiPos.tips: branch-policy controlled percentage or fixed tip with integer minor units
umiPos.discounts: branch-policy controlled line or order discount with reason and manager approval
umiPos.managerApproval: one-use, short-expiry, manager-role and permission checked; each grant is bound to the full tender fingerprint
umiPos.checkoutRecovery: server recovery preserves drafts, timeout or unknown outcomes, and the immutable committed receipt result across a restarted operator session
umiPos.receiptDestination: display, print-later, digital intent contract, or no receipt where policy permits
umiPos.gate3BOfflineBoundary: one policy-authorized cash tender only; advanced tenders, tips, discounts, and live approval fail closed offline
umiPos.saleLifecycle: one editable tenant/branch/operator sale; start, suspend, resume, cancel, recover, and automatic next sale
umiPos.saleHistory: branch-scoped suspended, committed, and cancelled navigation with search, sort, filter, and cursor pagination
umiPos.customerAttachment: optional tenant customer reference; no CRM, loyalty, or checkout calculation changes
umiPos.receiptNavigation: official and provisional receipt navigation; no printer or fiscal hardware
umiPos.offlineJournal: native AES-256-GCM, schema 1, no plaintext fallback
umiPos.offlineReplay: ordered per device credential version; duplicate results recovered
umiPos.offlineCash: default-deny server-issued branch policy; eligible native cash checkout is encrypted and provisional
umiPos.offlineRecovery: generated-SDK gateway, serialized journal mutations, restart deduplication, ordered replay, typed recovery actions, response-loss query, reconciliation, immutable mapping, Recovery Center
umiPos.offlineDatabaseValidation: clean migration chain plus tenant, branch, device, credential, immutability, revocation and rotation negative matrix passed in disposable PostgreSQL
umiPos.nativeBuild: Linux debug build passed during Gate 3B
umiPos.webOfflineCapability: sensitive journaling unsupported; online operation only
umiPos.checkoutMode: online, immediately repriced, explicitly confirmed, idempotent
umiPos.paymentOrchestration: cash succeeds; external terminal unknown is query-only
umiPos.inventoryReservation: time-bounded snapshot; no permanent inventory mutation
umiPos.cartMode: server-authoritative sale preparation; no order commit
umiPos.catalogSearch: server-side name, description, SKU, and barcode
umiPos.devicePairing: one-time eight-character code, installation claim, administrator approval or denial, bounded polling, secure credential acknowledgement
umiPos.authentication: personal PIN resolves staff identity and creates credential-bound POS access and refresh tokens
umiPos.branchSelection: intersection of tenant, user, staff, and device scope
umiPos.pinFoundation: tenant-unique personal PIN, keyed lookup, server-side scrypt verification, bounded attempts, and no client role selection
